objective: The rainbow coat (decision 0058): any hatch has a small chance (1 in 200) to come out in a rainbow coat, a second texture for the same model, painted for every animal and variant. A look only.
acceptance_criteria: A hatch from any egg comes out rainbow 1 time in 200, whatever the animal or variant; its stats are those of the same animal without the coat
A rainbow animal shows its coat on the ranch, in a fight and in its pictures, and is named Rainbow on its card and when it hatches
The coat is saved with the animal; old saves load unchanged
The server decides the coat; a client cannot ask for one (the admin's menu apart)
verification: Not verified yet: built and exported, waiting for the upload and the check in Studio.
notes: SHANNON on 2026-11-16: 'add a rainbow texture that has a small chance to apply to any animal on hatch'. Checkpoint for SHANNON: the chance (1 in 200, one number in StationConfig); whether a rainbow animal should also be stronger (it is a look only).
